title: TurboQuant Pro weight cost table
description: The input record read by `tqp plan weights` (turboquant_pro.weight_plan.CostTable). It gives the per-matrix measured damage `costs[name][bits]` behind the exact multiple-choice knapsack, the matrix shapes needed to turn a bit width into a stored size, and the provenance the plan's content hash commits to. tqp.weight_cost_table/1.

model.description: The model the costs were measured on; a plan refuses a table from a different one.

predictor.description: How the damage was predicted, e.g. a measured single-matrix KL or a diagonal weight Fisher.

matrices.description: Matrix name -> shape. `group` is the quantization group size and defaults to 128 when absent.

costs.description: Matrix name -> {bit width as a string key -> damage}. Keys are the choices the solver may pick from, so every matrix needs at least one; the damage is a non-negative finite measurement and names the same matrices as `matrices`.

provenance.description: Free-form origin of the measurements (model revision, calibration split, predictor seed). Hashed into `cost_table_hash`, so changing it changes every plan made from this table.
